verdict.rationale: Brex's developer portal lists a dedicated "Accounting API: View and manage accounting data," which matches the story directly. It sits alongside a broader documented API suite with a quickstart guide and an llms.txt index. The evidence is only a one-line catalog entry, however, with no detail on endpoints or operations. Missing for 10: documented endpoints and resources showing what accounting data can be read and written, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Accounting API in use.
